subject: Intro + demo for FinnovA — quick qualification
messages:
From: Sam Green <sam.green@finnova.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-11T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Quick demo request — signed up today

Hi Kimberly,

I signed up for Redwood this morning (trial account: finnova-trial) and poked around the self-serve flow. I think Redwood could fit our inference needs for a new fintech feature, but I want to get a short walkthrough of latency/cost expectations and deployment options before committing to a pilot.

High level: we're building a transaction categorization API that will run in our US cloud region and needs PII-safe handling. Expected ramp is ~150k inference requests/month in Q3, with spikes up to ~20 req/s. Target go-live Q4 (beta).

Can we do a 30-min demo this week? Prefer mornings PST. Also: any quick checklist I should complete before the call?

Thanks,
Sam Green
Lead Engineering Manager, FinnovA
Attachments: none
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Green <sam.green@finnova.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-11T10:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo request — signed up today

Hi Sam — great to meet you, and welcome to Redwood. Thanks for the context; those numbers are helpful. Quick follow-ups so we can make the demo specific to FinnovA's constraints: 

1) Are the 150k requests/month single-turn text-generation calls (one prompt/response) or chat-style multi-turn sessions with context?
2) Typical average tokens per request (prompt + expected response)? Ballpark is fine (e.g., 200 tokens).
3) Do you need data to stay in your VPC/on-prem, or is hosted Redwood acceptable for the pilot? Any compliance requirements beyond SOC2 (e.g., PCI scope avoidance)?
4) Who should attend from your side (engineering, security, product)?

Slots I have open (PST): Thu 4/13 9:30–10:00, Thu 4/13 11:00–11:30, Fri 4/14 8:30–9:00. If none work, send a couple options and we'll adapt.

If you want to try a short pre-demo checklist, I've attached a one-pager with sandbox steps and a quick network checklist (sandbox-steps.pdf). Also including Ben (AE) who will run the demo and cover pricing/rollout options.

Best,
Kimberly Park
SDR, Redwood Inference
Attachments: sandbox-steps.pdf
From: Sam Green <sam.green@finnova.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olivia Park <olivia.park@finnova.io>
Date: 2027-04-11T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo request — signed up today

Thanks Kimberly — answers below. Feel free to forward to Ben and the demo team.

1) Mostly single-turn generation for now (categorization prompt -> label). We may add light context in Q4 but not heavy multi-turn chat.
2) Average tokens per request: ~120 (prompt ~40, response ~80).
3) Hosted Redwood is preferable for a pilot; we will need SOC2 evidence and a signed DSPA or DPA (security will ask). No PCI processing on this pipeline, but the data includes tokenized account IDs and hashed PAN fragments.
4) Attendees: me (lead eng), Olivia Park (security lead), product PM (TBD).

Any of the Thu slots work for me — let's take Thu 4/13 11:00–11:30 PST.

Also: I uploaded our initial traffic profile to the trial account (traffic.json) and tried the example embedding call — happy to share logs if useful.

Sam
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Green <sam.green@finnova.io>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-12T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo request — signed up today

Hi Sam — Ben here, I'll run the demo on Thurs 4/13 and tailor it to your volume and compliance questions. Agenda (30 min):

- 5 min: intros + goals
- 10 min: live demo (hosting options, runtime performance, batching & KV cache basics)
- 10 min: cost/rollout options and pilot checklist
- 5 min: next steps (pilot SOW, security docs)

Quick notes pre-call: can you confirm whether your traffic.json is representative of peak-day traffic (we'll use that to sketch latencies)? Also attaching a draft SOW template we typically use for pilots (SOW-template.docx). Please send any security checklist items you want covered and we'll bring our security engineer on the follow-up if needed.

I'll send a calendar invite to Sam and Olivia for Thu 2027-04-13 11:00–11:30 PST. If anything changes, reply-all and we'll reschedule.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: SOW-template.docx
